topic_ko: 진화는 멈추지 않고 변화하는 환경을 추적한다
_note: 유형별 묶음 구조. 같은 33번 지문이라도 유형마다 passage를 다르게 paraphrase 한다. order/insert/irrelevant/writing 은 구조상 예외.

passage: Evolution would grind to a halt only if nothing in the environment ever changed.
But over the vast stretch of evolutionary time, the conditions almost always do change.
An ice age may begin, the average rainfall may shift, or the prevailing winds may move.
Because such changes keep occurring, evolution does not actually stop; instead it constantly tracks the shifting environment.
Suppose the average temperature of an area drifts steadily downward over many centuries.
Then successive generations of animals will be pushed by selection pressure toward growing longer coats of hair.
If the temperature later reverses and creeps upward again, a new selection pressure takes over.
Under that new pressure, the same animals are nudged back toward shorter coats.
choices: how evolution keeps pace with an environment that is always changing
why ice ages are the single greatest driver of animal evolution
how animals consciously decide to grow longer or shorter coats
why rainfall is more important to survival than temperature
how scientists measure the exact speed of evolutionary change
theme.explanation_ko: 환경 조건이 끊임없이 변하므로 진화도 멈추지 않고 그 변화를 계속 추적한다는 내용. '진화가 늘 변하는 환경에 발맞춘다'가 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ②빙하기가 최대 동인, ③동물의 의식적 선택, ④강수량 우위, ⑤진화 속도 측정은 본문 초점이 아니다.

passage: We should not picture evolution as something that finishes and then stops for good.
It would only stand still if the environment itself stayed perfectly fixed, which it never does for long.
Across centuries, temperatures drift, rainfall shifts, and prevailing winds change direction.
Because the environment keeps moving, the selection pressures acting on animals keep moving too.
A long cooling trend pushes successive generations toward longer coats of hair.
When that trend later reverses, a new pressure pushes them back toward shorter coats.
We must therefore understand evolution as an ongoing process that never settles into a final state.
To call any species 'finished' is to misread how living change actually works.
choices: 진화는 끝나서 멈추는 것이 아니라 환경 변화에 따라 끊임없이 진행되는 과정으로 이해해야 한다.
빙하기가 오면 모든 동물은 즉시 더 긴 털을 갖게 된다.
강수량은 진화에서 기온보다 더 중요한 요인이다.
동물은 환경이 변할 때 스스로 털 길이를 조절한다.
진화의 속도는 시간이 지날수록 점점 빨라진다.
claim.explanation_ko: 환경이 끊임없이 변하므로 진화도 최종 상태에 머무르지 않고 계속 진행된다는 것으로 이해해야 한다는 주장. ①이 정답.
claim.distractor_ko: ②즉각적 변화, ③강수량 우위, ④동물의 의식적 조절, ⑤속도 가속은 본문 주장과 무관하다.

passage: Evolution pauses only when nothing in the surrounding conditions is changing.
Yet on evolutionary timescales, conditions such as temperature and rainfall hardly ever stay still.
As a result, evolution does not come to a halt but keeps tracking the changing environment.
A steady, centuries-long drop in temperature steers animals toward growing longer coats.
Should the temperature later climb again, a fresh selection pressure appears.
That new pressure nudges the same animals back toward shorter coats.
Evolution, in short, is always following wherever the environment leads.
It chases a target that itself never stops moving.
choices: 기온이 내려가면 동물의 털은 영구히 길어진다.
진화는 환경이 안정될 때 가장 빠르게 일어난다.
진화는 멈추지 않고 변화하는 환경을 끊임없이 추적한다.
동물은 환경 변화를 예측하여 미리 적응한다.
gist.explanation_ko: 환경이 변하면 선택압도 따라 변하므로 진화가 멈추지 않고 그 변화를 추적한다는 것이 요지. ③이 정답.
gist.distractor_ko: ①영구적 변화, ②안정 시 가속, ④강수량만, ⑤예측 적응은 근거 없다.

passage: Imagine that nothing in an environment ever shifted; only then would evolution truly stop.
But ice ages begin, rainfall patterns move, and prevailing winds change over the centuries.
Because the environment keeps changing, evolution keeps tracking it rather than halting.
A long downward drift in temperature steadily pushes animals toward longer coats of hair.
If the climate later warms again, a new selection pressure reverses the trend.
Then the very same animals are pushed back toward shorter coats.
Evolution is thus less a destination than a constant act of following.
It keeps adjusting because the world it answers to keeps moving.
choices: Ice Ages and the End of Animal Life
How Animals Choose Their Own Fur Length
Rainfall: The Hidden Key to Survival
Measuring the True Speed of Evolution
A Moving Target: Evolution Never Stands Still
title.explanation_ko: 진화가 끊임없이 변하는 환경을 따라간다는 핵심을 압축한 ⑤가 제목.
title.distractor_ko: ①빙하기 종말, ②동물의 선택, ③강수량, ④속도 측정은 초점이 아니다.

passage: Evolution would stop only if the environment stopped changing first.
But over long timescales the climate keeps drifting, so evolution keeps moving with it.
A centuries-long cooling trend pushes animals toward longer coats of hair.
If warming later returns, a fresh pressure pushes them back toward shorter coats.
Evolution therefore constantly tracks the changing environment.
It never reaches a finish line and rests there.
Instead, it keeps running after a goalpost that is always being moved.
Standing still is simply not an option as long as the world keeps turning.
implication.underlined: running after a goalpost that is always being moved
choices: evolution eventually arrives at one perfect, final form
animals deliberately relocate to avoid changing climates
evolution keeps adjusting because the environment keeps changing
scientists keep revising their definitions of evolution
evolution speeds up whenever the climate grows warmer
implication.explanation_ko: '계속 옮겨지는 골대를 쫓는다'는 비유는 환경이 끊임없이 변하기에 진화도 끝없이 그에 맞춰 조정된다는 뜻이다. ③이 정답.
implication.distractor_ko: ①최종 완성형 도달, ②동물의 이주, ④정의 수정, ⑤온난화 시 가속은 비유의 의미와 다르다.

passage: Evolution would come to a standstill only if something in the conditions stopped changing.
Such changes do happen when we are dealing with a timescale as long the evolutionary one.
As a consequence, evolution normally does not come to a halt, but constantly tracks the changing environment.
If there is a steady downward drift in temperature, successive generations will be propelled toward growing longer coats of hair.
The drift persists over centuries, pushing animals steadily in one direction.
If the trend later reverses and average temperatures creep up again, the animals will come under a new selection pressure.
Under that pressure, they will be pushed toward growing shorter coats again.
grammar.explanation_ko: ② 원급 비교 구문은 'as + 형용사 + as'의 형태여야 하므로 'as long the evolutionary one'은 두 번째 as가 빠진 비문이다. 'as long as the'가 옳다. ②가 정답.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①if절 과거동사 stopped, ③주어 evolution에 호응하는 tracks, ④전치사 toward 뒤 동명사 growing, ⑤and로 reverses와 병렬되는 정동사 creep은 모두 옳다.

passage: Evolution would come to a standstill only if the surrounding conditions stopped changing.
Such changes do happen on a timescale as long as the evolutionary one.
As a consequence, evolution does not halt but constantly tracks the changing environment.
A steady downward drift in temperature propels successive generations toward shorter coats of hair.
The drift persists over centuries, steadily favoring warmer-coated animals.
If the trend later reverses and temperatures rise again, a new selection pressure appears.
Under that pressure, the animals are pushed toward shorter coats once more.
vocab.explanation_ko: ③ 기온이 꾸준히 '하락'하면 동물은 추위를 견디기 위해 '더 긴(longer)' 털 쪽으로 밀려야 하므로 '더 짧은(shorter)'은 정반대 의미라 부적절하다. longer coats로 고쳐야 한다. ③이 정답.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①standstill(정지), ②tracks(추적하다), ④reverses(역전되다), ⑤shorter(기온 상승 시 더 짧은 털)는 문맥에 적절하다.

passage: Evolution would come to a standstill only if the conditions ever stopped changing.
But on an evolutionary timescale, ice ages begin, rainfall shifts, and prevailing winds move.
As a consequence, evolution normally does not come to a halt, but instead __________.
Consider a steady downward drift in temperature that lasts for many centuries.
Successive generations of animals are then propelled toward growing longer coats of hair.
If the trend later reverses and temperatures creep up again, a new selection pressure appears.
Under it, the animals are pushed back toward growing shorter coats.
The direction of change simply follows wherever the climate goes.
choices: slows down as the centuries pass
blank.explanation_ko: 빈칸 뒤에서 기온이 내려가면 긴 털, 올라가면 짧은 털로 방향이 바뀌는 예시가 이어지므로 '끊임없이 변하는 환경을 추적한다(constantly tracks the changing environment)'가 들어간다. ⑤가 정답.
blank.distractor_ko: ①기후에 대한 반응 중단, ②동일한 자손, ③세기마다 둔화, ④대형 동물만 선호는 뒤 사례와 맞지 않는다.

irrelevant.intro: Evolution would come to a standstill only if nothing in the conditions ever changed, but over evolutionary time the conditions almost always do.
sentences: An ice age may begin, the average rainfall may shift, or the prevailing wind may change direction.
As a consequence, evolution does not come to a halt but constantly tracks the changing environment.
A steady downward drift in temperature propels successive generations of animals toward growing longer coats of hair.
If the trend later reverses and temperatures rise, a new selection pressure pushes the animals toward shorter coats again.
Many zoos today keep cold-climate animals in carefully air-conditioned enclosures for visitors to enjoy.
irrelevant.explanation_ko: 글은 '진화가 변화하는 환경을 추적한다'는 흐름인데 ⑤ '동물원이 냉방 우리를 운영한다'는 무관한 내용이다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ①②③④는 모두 환경 변화에 따라 선택압이 바뀌며 진화가 그것을 추적한다는 주제로 연결된다.

order.given: Evolution would come to a standstill only if the conditions stopped changing, but over the long evolutionary timescale they almost always do change.

blocks.A: As a consequence, evolution does not actually come to a halt, but instead constantly tracks the changing environment.
blocks.B: For example, a steady downward drift in temperature over centuries propels successive generations of animals toward growing longer coats of hair.
blocks.C: Then, if the trend later reverses and temperatures creep up again, a new selection pressure pushes those same animals back toward shorter coats.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글의 '조건은 늘 변한다'를 (A)가 'As a consequence'로 결론(환경 추적)으로 잇고, (B)가 'For example'로 기온 하락 사례를, (C)가 'Then'으로 역전 사례를 이어 마무리. (A)-(B)-(C).
order.distractor_ko: (C)의 Then은 앞선 하락 사례(B) 뒤라야 하고, (A)의 As a consequence는 주어진 글 바로 뒤 결론이라 첫 순서이다.

insert.insert_sentence: If the trend later reverses and temperatures creep up again, the animals come under a new selection pressure.

passage_marked.text: Evolution would come to a standstill only if the conditions stopped changing.
But over the evolutionary timescale, ice ages, rainfall, and winds keep shifting.
As a consequence, evolution does not halt but constantly tracks the changing environment.
A steady downward drift in temperature propels successive generations toward growing longer coats of hair.
Under that new pressure, the animals are pushed back toward growing shorter coats.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장은 기온이 다시 오르는 '역전'을 도입하며, 기온 하락→긴 털(④ 문장) 뒤이자 '그 새로운 선택압 아래 짧은 털'(⑤ 문장) 앞에 와야 한다. ④가 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: 주어진 문장이 없으면 'Under that new pressure'의 그 '새로운 선택압'이 무엇인지 알 수 없다.

passage: Evolution would only stop if the environment stopped changing.
But across evolutionary time, temperature, rainfall, and winds keep shifting.
So evolution does not halt; it constantly tracks the changing environment.
A long cooling trend pushes animals toward longer coats of hair.
If warming later returns, a new selection pressure takes over.
That pressure pushes the same animals back toward shorter coats.
Evolution thus follows the environment wherever it leads.
It never settles, because the conditions never settle either.
summary.summary_template: Because environmental conditions never stay __(A)__, evolution does not stop but continually __(B)__ those changes through shifting selection pressures.
summary.explanation_ko: 환경이 (A)constant(일정)하지 않으므로 진화는 멈추지 않고 그 변화를 (B)follows(따라간다). ④.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 constant(일정한, 부정문 맥락), (B)는 follows여야 한다. ignores/resists는 반대 의미이고, ⑤changing은 'never stay changing'이 되어 의미가 어긋난다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 진화는 멈추지 않고 변화하는 환경을 끊임없이 추적한다.
writing.answer: Evolution does not halt but constantly tracks the changing environment.
writing.explanation_ko: does not halt와 (does) constantly tracks가 but으로 병렬.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그 동물들은 더 짧은 털을 기르는 쪽으로 밀려갈 것이다.
writing.answer: The animals will be pushed toward growing shorter coats.
writing.explanation_ko: 수동태 will be pushed + toward + 동명사 growing shorter coats.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 기온이 꾸준히 내려가면, 잇따른 세대는 더 긴 털을 기르는 쪽으로 밀려갈 것이다.
conditions: 수동태 will be propelled를 사용할 것
writing.answer: If the temperature drifts downward, successive generations will be propelled toward growing longer coats.
writing.explanation_ko: If절(현재시제) + 주절(will be propelled toward + 동명사).

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: Because the conditions keep changing, evolution does not come to a halt but constantly ___________ the changing environment.
writing.explanation_ko: 진화가 변화하는 환경을 '추적한다(tracks)'는 본문 핵심 동사.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: As a consequence, evolution normally does not come to a halt, but constantly tracks the changing environment.
writing.answer: 그 결과, 진화는 보통 멈추지 않고, 변화하는 환경을 끊임없이 추적한다.
writing.explanation_ko: come to a halt(멈추다), constantly track(끊임없이 추적하다).
